name: Blank-State Guidance
blueprintProse:
Blank-state interfaces distribute their word budget across three primary tasks: confirming zero-state status (25%), introducing the operational leverage unlocked upon setup (35%), and providing a single call-to-action to begin onboarding (40%). 
This pattern leverages the goal-gradient effect and minimizes activation energy. Encountering an unpopulated application screen often induces choice paralysis and user confusion. Structuring the blank state as a clear launching pad with a guided onboarding step accelerates time-to-value and drives early product adoption.
template: No [Domain Objects] Configured Yet Add your first [Domain Object] to unlock [Concrete Operational Automation]. Setup takes under [X] minutes. [ + Create My First [Domain Object] ]

example.bland: No API Keys Created Yet You have not generated any secret keys. Click the button below if you want to make an API key for your account.
example.optimized: Zero Live Production Keys Configured Generate your first read-only authentication token to begin querying telemetry endpoints over encrypted TLS. Integrates in 60 seconds via our curl quickstart. [Generate Production Key →]
